title: What The Garden Knows (Wilma McIvor)
style: folk country acoustic guitar warm female vocal 100bpm brushed drums gentle storytelling intimate garden wisdom seasons family Perth
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The garden knows when you haven't been paying attention
It shows you in the weeds without a word of intervention
It knows the summer's coming three weeks before you do
The garden's been preparing while you were doing something through

[Pre-Chorus]
I have been coming to this garden for thirty years or more
And the garden has been patient with me — that's what gardens are for

[Chorus]
What does the garden know that I don't know?
It knows that things take time and time is how things grow
What does the garden know in the quiet of the dawn?
It knows that everything you planted will keep coming back with the morn
The gardens still growing

[Verse 2]
The soil remembers what was planted ten years back
The roots of something long removed still leave their track
The garden doesn't argue and the garden doesn't rest
The garden simply goes about the quiet business of its best

[Bridge]
I planted things here that were for the children and they grew
And the children grew as well — the garden always knew
What it was for and what the season asked of it and when
The garden knows before you do and will know after then

[Outro]
What the garden knows… the soil knows… the roots know…
The gardens still growing
